name: stop-motion
title: Stop Motion
description: An animation block in the page's dedicated stop-motion/ folder: upload or delete frame files (any continuous-numbering, gaps tolerated, filenames only), set the fps, and the block plays them as a pure-CSS stop-motion. The canvas modal manages frames end to end; the serve-time filter decodes the ```stop-motion fence into stacked, CSS-only frames. Malformed fences stay visible in the md: degrades, never dead.
